title_zh: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主
source_file: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
茉莉公主被黑暗城堡的大魔王抓走了，国王派出了好多士兵去解救公主，可是过了好几天，还是没有把茉莉公主救回来。
“我们还有多少士兵？”国王着急地问大臣，“全部派出去，一定要把茉莉公主救回来。”
“零个士兵。”大臣很无奈。
0个士兵，也就是说一个士兵都没有！
page_text_en:
Princess茉莉 was captured by the big demon in the dark castle. The king sent out many soldiers to rescue her, but after several days, they still hadn't rescued Princess茉莉.
"How many soldiers do we have left?" the king anxiously asked the minister, "Send them all out. We must rescue Princess茉莉."
"Zero soldiers," the minister replied helplessly.
Zero soldiers means there are no soldiers at all!
summary_zh: 本页讲述了茉莉公主被大魔王抓走后，国王派兵救援却失败，询问大臣剩余士兵数量，大臣回答‘零个士兵’，说明已无兵可用。

title_zh: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主
source_file: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
国王贴出紧急告示，招募新兵。王国里的好多小伙子去应征，原来他们都想把公主娶回家。
国王又有了好多士兵，他们一起去解救公主。

紧急告示
招士兵，如果哪个士兵能把公主
救回来，我就把公主嫁给他。

国王
1 月 1 日

通往黑暗城堡的路充满了危险。在必须经过的隧道里，大魔王派了
吸血蝙蝠守在那里。
一、二、三、四、五、六，有六只吸血蝙蝠。要是被吸血蝙蝠咬到
就麻烦了，士兵们吓坏了。
page_text_en:
The king posted an urgent notice to recruit new soldiers. Many young men from the kingdom came to sign up, as they all wanted to marry the princess.
The king now had many soldiers again, and they set off together to rescue the princess.

Urgent Notice
Recruiting soldiers. If any soldier can rescue the princess,
I will marry her to him.

King
January 1st

The path to the dark castle is full of danger. In the tunnel they must pass through, the evil wizard has placed blood-sucking bats.
One, two, three, four, five, six—there are six blood-sucking bats. If bitten by one, it would be a problem, and the soldiers were frightened.
summary_zh: 国王发布告示招募新兵，许多小伙子应征加入，组成救援队伍。他们前往黑暗城堡途中，发现隧道里有六只吸血蝙蝠守卫，士兵们因此感到害怕。

title_zh: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主
source_file: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
其中一个高个子士兵很聪明，他让大家拿出国王给的夜明珠。隧道立即变得明亮无比，蝙蝠最怕光了。唰唰唰，吸血蝙蝠们一只一只全都飞走了。现在，隧道里有零只蝙蝠。0！
士兵们走过隧道，继续前往黑暗城堡。高山上，大魔王派了巨人守在那里。一、二、三、四，有四个巨人。要是被巨人抓到就麻烦了，他们只要轻轻一扔，就能把人扔得老远。
page_text_en:
One tall soldier was very clever. He told everyone to take out the night pearls given by the king. The tunnel immediately became bright, and bats are afraid of light. Swish, swish, swish, the blood-sucking bats flew away one by one. Now, there are zero bats in the tunnel. 0!

The soldiers walked through the tunnel and continued toward the dark castle. On the high mountain, the big demon king had sent giants to guard there. One, two, three, four—there are four giants. If caught by the giants, it would be a big problem, because they could throw a person far away with just a light toss.
summary_zh: 士兵们用国王给的夜明珠照亮隧道，赶走了所有吸血蝙蝠，隧道里剩下零只蝙蝠。随后他们继续前往黑暗城堡，发现高山上驻守着四个巨人，担心被抓住后会被轻易扔远。

title_zh: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主
source_file: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
其中一个矮个子士兵很聪明，
他让大家取下旁边大树上的马蜂
窝，然后甩到巨人身上。

巨人被马蜂蛰得嗷嗷叫，抱着
头全都跑了。
现在，高山上有零个巨人。0！

士兵们翻过高山，继续前往黑暗城堡。
草原上，大魔王派了许多许多的毒蚂蚁守在
那里。要是被毒蚂蚁叮咬了就糟糕了，就不能去
救公主了。

其中一个胖胖的士兵很聪明，他看到草原上
的草都枯了，就点了一把火。毒蚂蚁们一看到火，
就吓得四处逃窜。

现在，草原上有零只毒蚂蚁。0！
page_text_en:
One short soldier was very clever.
He told everyone to take down the beehives from the big tree nearby, and then throw them onto the giants.

The giants were stung by the bees and screamed, holding their heads and running away.
Now, there are zero giants on the mountain. 0!

The soldiers climbed over the mountain and continued toward the Dark Castle.
On the grassland, the Big Demon had sent many, many poisonous ants to guard the area. If bitten by the ants, it would be terrible, and they couldn't rescue the princess.

One plump soldier was very clever. He saw that the grass on the plain had dried up, so he lit a fire. The poisonous ants, seeing the fire, were scared and scattered everywhere.

Now, there are zero poisonous ants on the grassland. 0!
summary_zh: 士兵们用马蜂窝赶跑了高山上的巨人，用火驱散了草原上的毒蚂蚁，成功通过两个障碍，继续前往黑暗城堡。

title_zh: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主
source_file: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
森林里，大魔王派了小魔怪守在那里。小魔怪们个个拿着毒烟袋，就等着攻击士兵呢，士兵们要是吸入毒烟就会晕倒。
其中一个小魔怪的士兵很聪明，他让大家去挠小魔怪们的胳肢窝。小魔怪们被挠得哈哈大笑，丢下毒烟袋，在地上打滚。
士兵们捡起毒烟袋，并且顺利闯入黑暗城堡。他们把毒烟悄悄放进大魔王的房间里，大魔王被毒烟熏晕了。公主得救了。
士兵们把公主带回了王宫。
page_text_en:
In the forest, the Big Demon King sent little monsters to guard the area. Each little monster held a poisonous smoke pouch, waiting to attack the soldiers. If the soldiers inhaled the smoke, they would faint.
One clever little monster soldier had an idea. He told everyone to tickle the monsters' armpits. The little monsters laughed uncontrollably, dropped their smoke pouches, and rolled on the ground.
The soldiers picked up the smoke pouches and successfully entered the Dark Castle. They quietly placed the smoke inside the Big Demon King's room, and the king was knocked out by the fumes. The princess was rescued.
The soldiers brought the princess back to the palace.
summary_zh: 士兵们在森林中用挠胳肢窝的方法制服了守卫的小魔怪，捡起毒烟袋后顺利闯入黑暗城堡，将毒烟放入大魔王房间使其晕倒，成功救出公主并将其带回王宫。

title_zh: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主
source_file: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
现在，有件非常麻烦的事情：因为是所有士兵一起找到公主的，可是公主只能嫁给一个士兵。怎么办呢？
公主饿坏了，还是等她吃饱了，再来决定嫁给谁吧！
厨师做了八个大汉堡。
茉莉公主饿坏了，几口就吃下了一个汉堡。
还有七个汉堡。7！
还有六个汉堡。6！
还有五个汉堡。5！
还有四个汉堡。4！
还有三个汉堡。3！
还有两个汉堡。2！
还有一个汉堡。1！
还有零个汉堡。0！
天哪！汉堡都被吃完了。
可怜的茉莉公主，大魔王肯定一直没给她东西吃，她真是饿坏了。
page_text_en:
Now, there's a very tricky problem: since all the soldiers found the princess together, but the princess can only marry one soldier. What should we do?
Princess is starving, let's wait until she's full, then decide who to marry!
The chef made eight big hamburgers.
Princess茉莉 is starving, and she ate one hamburger in a few bites.
There are seven hamburgers left. 7!
There are six hamburgers left. 6!
There are five hamburgers left. 5!
There are four hamburgers left. 4!
There are three hamburgers left. 3!
There are two hamburgers left. 2!
There is one hamburger left. 1!
There are zero hamburgers left. 0!
Oh my! All the hamburgers are gone.
Poor Princess茉莉, the big demon king must have never given her any food. She's really starving.
summary_zh: 士兵们救出茉莉公主后，因公主只能嫁给一个士兵而陷入难题。国王决定让公主吃饱后再做决定，厨师做了八个汉堡，公主一口气吃完，最终剩下零个汉堡，说明她非常饥饿。

title_zh: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主
source_file: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
厨师又给公主做了五碗面条。
茉莉公主很快吃完了一碗，还有四碗面条。4！
还有三碗面条。3！
还有两碗面条。2！
还有一碗面条。1！
还有零碗面条。0！
接下来，茉莉公主还吃了十根烤肠，
两个蛋糕。
呃，茉莉公主吃得确实是有点儿多！
不过肚子饿的时候，多吃一些东西，这
也是可以理解的嘛。
page_text_en:
The chef made five bowls of noodles for the princess.
Princess茉莉 quickly finished one bowl, leaving four bowls. 4!
There are three bowls left. 3!
There are two bowls left. 2!
There is one bowl left. 1!
There are zero bowls left. 0!
Next, Princess茉莉 also ate ten sausages,
two cakes.
Well, Princess茉莉 did eat quite a lot!
But when you're hungry, eating more is understandable.
summary_zh: 厨师为茉莉公主做了五碗面条，她一口气吃完，随后又吃了十根烤肠和两个蛋糕，因饥饿而大量进食，旁白表示理解。

title_zh: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主
source_file: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
茉莉公主吃饱了，可以选驸马了。
可当她来到骑马场——
骑马场上空空的，有零个士兵。0！
谁能告诉茉莉公主，这是怎么回事？
士兵们经过讨论，决定：待会儿等茉莉公主吃饱了，他们就去
骑马场进行骑马比赛，赢的人娶公主。
他们正要前往骑马场的时候，大臣说：“我们公主的胃口一直都这么好。”
page_text_en:
Princess茉莉 has eaten her fill and can now choose a prince.
But when she arrives at the riding arena—
the arena is empty, with zero soldiers. 0!
Who can tell Princess茉莉 what's going on?
The soldiers discuss and decide: after Princess茉莉 has eaten her fill, they will go to the riding arena for a horse-riding competition, and the winner will marry the princess.
As they are about to head to the riding arena, the minister says, "Our princess has always had such a big appetite."
summary_zh: 士兵们计划在茉莉公主吃饱后举行骑马比赛决定驸马，但公主到达骑马场时发现空无一人，大臣解释公主胃口一直很好。

title_zh: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主
source_file: 了解数学0：解救茉莉公主（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
茉莉公主在吃早餐，哪个盘子里的食物是零呢？
请在盘子上面贴上“0”。
茉莉公主有好多鞋子，请数一数，鞋柜里面分别有几双鞋子，
并贴上相应的数字。
page_text_en:
Princess茉莉 is having breakfast. Which plate has zero food?
Please stick a "0" on that plate.
Princess茉莉 has many shoes. Please count how many pairs are on each shelf,
and stick the corresponding number.
summary_zh: 本页展示了茉莉公主吃早餐和整理鞋子的场景，包含两个互动练习：找出食物为零的盘子，并数出鞋柜中每层鞋子的对数。
